# =============================================================================
# dependencies/apt.txt — the distro-agnostic package list. One package per line;
# the trailing tag decides which image stages get it.
#
# Filtering Tag System Guide:
#   - # runtime : Packages required by deployment artifacts
#   - # dev     : Full development image only; excluded from production builders
#   - # gui     : Interactive desktop tools excluded from production builders
#   - # ros1    : ROS 1 (noetic) images only
#   - # ros2    : ROS 2 images only — every ROS 2 distro, not one in particular
#   - # !<distro> : skipped for that distro (e.g. !foxy) — for packages that
#                 moved between releases
#   - (No tag)  : Installed in dev and production builder environments
#
# Examples:
#   - libyaml-cpp-dev # runtime         (dev images and deployment artifacts)
#   - python3-catkin-tools # ros1    (ROS1 dev-only tool)
# =============================================================================

# Build & Utilities
ccache
ninja-build

# GUI terminal for `make term` (opt-in). terminator pulls GTK/VTE into every
# dev image, so it is offered, not installed. A matching font is opt-in too:
# drop D2Coding.zip (github.com/naver/d2codingfont) into dependencies/.
# terminator # gui

# Quality loop (opt-in). The editor formats C/C++ with the copy bundled in the
# C/C++ extension, so `mlint`'s CLI half is the only thing that needs this —
# and clang-format pulls libllvm, which the dev image otherwise avoids.
# Python needs nothing here: ruff ships in src/pyproject.toml's `dev` group.
# clang-format # dev

# Runtime graphics (opt-in for deployed apps that need OpenGL/EGL or non-headless OpenCV)
# libegl1-mesa # runtime
# libgl1-mesa-dri # runtime
# libglx-mesa0 # runtime
